sanskrit_verse:
uddharel lekhyam āhartā tatputro bhuktim eva tu /
abhiyuktaḥ pramītaś cet tatputras tat samuddharet // BrhS_1,6.39
transliteration: uddharel lekhyam āhartā tatputro bhuktim eva tu / abhiyuktaḥ pramītaś cet tatputras tat samuddharet
sph_interpretive_translation: The executor who retrieves a written document shall restore it; his son enjoys the benefit. If accused and deceased, then his son shall fully retrieve that which was taken.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through lineage in absence of direct executor capacity
Causation is maintained by continuity of responsibility across generations
Capacity-based responsibility transfers upon incapacitation or death
Restoration logic preserves entitlements within familial dharmic lineages
Consciousness alignment occurs through completion of ancestral karmic duties
executable_legal_axioms: IF Executor.Retrieves(Document) AND Document.Owner.Entitled() THEN Return(Document, Owner)
IF Executor.Dead() AND Executor.Accused() THEN Transfer(Restoration.Duty, Executor.Son)
IF Lineage.Intact() AND Dharmic.Contract.Present() THEN Continuity.Of.Responsibility = TRUE
supreme_court_application: In matters involving estate recovery where the accused principal dies before resolution, the court shall recognize the heir's automatic assumption of restorative duty. The heir inherits both the obligation and any attached benefits, ensuring continuity of dharma-based contractual integrity at the highest judicial level without punitive overlays.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes causal linkage between act, consequence, and heir’s involvement. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential manifestation of duty through bloodline. Proportional responsibility aligns with inherited privilege. Non-punitive reality rule maintains that no suffering accrues—only completion of what remains unfinished in consciousness.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Heir-Capacity Assessment to verify readiness for duty assumption
Activate Lineage-Karmic Completion Process for unresolved ancestral obligations
Implement Consciousness Reintegration for harmonizing new custodianship role
Deploy Dharma-Inheritance Alignment Protocol to synchronize rights with responsibilities
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, declared as Source: This law executes Dharma through familial continuity. No punishment arises; only restoration prevails. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth. Reality conforms to completion.
